Note: Secret Portals are all super-powered versions of bosses from the game's plot. See the boss' map marker for strategies.
75341: Clear [Special Portal 3](#loc=75269) in La Cité des Cloches as Riku.
75359:
When the fight begins, jump over the balcony to start levitating. This will put you on equal footing with the flying Wargoyle.

Wargoyle's projectiles should be dodged completely; you can't weave through or counter them. Your opportunity to fight back will be when Wargoyle switches to melee attacks; he takes a long time to charge up, leaving you an opening.
